description: Explicit opt-in guarded authentication rule set. Local conditional hypotheses, not transition probabilities. Default CLI rules remain unchanged.

rules.rationale: An Analyst-established cohort of repeated online authentication failures may precede future valid-account use when the named account can authenticate and the source can reach its endpoint. Success is conditional, not observed or assumed. Offline cracking is excluded. Already-observed valid-account use must be handled as observed evidence. Expansion terminates at the predicted account-use step.
A valid account with execution privileges may be used to run PowerShell; account possession alone does not establish execution.
Elevated PowerShell execution creates an opportunity for attempted LSASS credential access; host protections may prevent it.
Credential access may enable attempted SMB lateral movement where an explicit can_access relationship supports reachability. Remote authorization remains an assumption.
